native_boundary: Preflight API call through private CSV report completion; startup/import excluded. Fresh processes. CPU is process CPU over the same boundary; memory is process-lifetime peak working set.
limitations: Warm serial workload only; no cache flush, CPU affinity/frequency pinning, cold SMB or production multiprocessing.
Background load and timing drift remain uncontrolled. No formal statistical significance claim.
Independent guarded comparisons have two samples per condition; reproducibility also assessed in the separate two-block pre-guard source.
No Linux runtime measurement; path matching retains the existing evaluator policy.
Dynamic inline Read File remains an explicit ordinary fallback, preserving existing parser limitations.
Profiles, phase clocks and preparation counters are separate diagnostics and excluded from native acceptance timing.
review_corrections: Discard negative exploded alternatives in flag and event-definition membership.
Use Context uppercase replacement-key equivalence for Unicode TEF proof, binding and include-selection guards.
Include TEF-dependent inline Read File names in explicit ordinary fallback.
